# E0323: value of an `if` without `else`

An `if` without `else` gives no value, so it can't end a block that gives one. Add the `else` branch.

- Rule: [`expressions.if`](../../reference/08-expressions.md#expressions.if)
- Reported at: the `if`.
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `types` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0323:2
fn label(n: i64) -> str {
  if n > 0 { "positive" }
  "zero or less"
}
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
fn label(n: i64) -> str {
  if n > 0 { "positive" } else { "zero or less" }
}
```

## What the compiler prints

`stilt check` on [`E0323_value_of_an_if_without_else.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0323_value_of_an_if_without_else.lt):

```text
── VALUE OF AN `if` WITHOUT `else` ── E0323_value_of_an_if_without_else.lt:2:3  [E0323]

An `if` without `else` can't have a value of type `str`:

  2 │   if n > 0 { "positive" }
    │   ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

An `if` without `else` gives no value, so it can't end a block that gives one.
Add the `else` branch.
```
